column3: CSP header not set: next.config.ts sets a CSP on every page; a page without one is a regression
Anti-clickjacking header missing: the app sends X-Frame-Options DENY + frame-ancestors 'none'
Cookie without HttpOnly: session/refresh cookies must never be readable by page scripts
Cookie without SameSite: SameSite is part of the CSRF defence (with the Origin check)
Cross-domain misconfiguration: no wildcard Access-Control-Allow-Origin anywhere (A4)
CORS misconfiguration (active): the widget surface may reflect only allow-listed origins

column1: # Known false positives / accepted, kept visible as WARN with the reason.

column3: Cookie without Secure: the e2e stack is plain HTTP (COOKIE_SECURE=false); production sets Secure automatically
CSP unsafe-inline: static nonce-less CSP needs it for the App Router RSC payload and inline brand styles (next.config.ts)
No anti-CSRF tokens: CSRF is defended by SameSite cookies + the web Origin check, APIs use bearer tokens
Suspicious comments: matches inside minified framework bundles, not application code
Modern web application: informational detection that the app is a JS SPA
